items.heading: Beshbarmak
details: Key ingredients: boiled meat, flat noodles, onion broth
Boil lamb or beef with onion until very tender.
Cook wide flat noodles in the meat broth.
Slice the meat thinly and toss with the noodles.
Serve topped with a light onion broth sauce.

items.heading: Kazakh Plov
details: Key ingredients: rice, lamb, carrot, onion, garlic
Brown lamb with onion until golden.
Add julienned carrot and cook until softened.
Layer rice over the meat and carrots with whole garlic heads.
Add water and simmer covered until the rice is tender and fluffy.

items.heading: Plov
details: Ingredients: rice, oil/ghee, onion, whole spices, ginger-garlic, vegetables or meat, salt and stock/water.
Rinse and partly cook the rice.
Brown onion and spices, cook the vegetables/meat with seasoning, layer with rice and steam covered on low heat until tender.
